```{r}
recovery.MLE <- multiRL::rcv_d(
  estimate = "MLE",
  data = multiRL::TAB,
  id = 1,
  behrule = list(
    cue = c("A", "B", "C", "D"),
    rsp = c("A", "B", "C", "D")
  ),
  
  colnames = list(
    object = c("L_choice", "R_choice"), 
    reward = c("L_reward", "R_reward"),
    action = "Sub_Choose"
  ),
  models = list(multiRL::TD, multiRL::RSTD, multiRL::Utility),
  settings = list(
    list(name = "TD", policy = "off"), 
    list(name = "RSTD", policy = "off"), 
    list(name = "Utility", policy = "off")
  ),
  priors = list(
    list(
      alpha = function(x) {stats::rbeta(n = 1, shape1 = 2, shape2 = 2)}, 
      beta = function(x) {stats::rexp(n = 1, rate = 1)}
    ),
    list(
      alphaN = function(x) {stats::rbeta(n = 1, shape1 = 2, shape2 = 2)}, 
      alphaP = function(x) {stats::rbeta(n = 1, shape1 = 2, shape2 = 2)}, 
      beta = function(x) {stats::rexp(n = 1, rate = 1)}
    ),
    list(
      alpha = function(x) {stats::rbeta(n = 1, shape1 = 2, shape2 = 2)}, 
      beta = function(x) {stats::rexp(n = 1, rate = 1)},
      gamma = function(x) {stats::rbeta(n = 1, shape1 = 2, shape2 = 2)}
    )
  ),
  
  algorithm = c("NLOPT_GN_MLSL", "NLOPT_LN_BOBYQA"),
  lowers = list(c(0, 0), c(0, 0, 0), c(0, 0, 0)),
  uppers = list(c(1, 5), c(1, 1, 5), c(1, 5, 1)),
  control = list(core = 20, sample = 100, iter = 100)
)
```


```{r}
replay.recovery <- multiRL::rpl_e(
  result = recovery.MLE,

  behrule = list(
    cue = c("A", "B", "C", "D"),
    rsp = c("A", "B", "C", "D")
  ),
  
  colnames = list(

    reward = c("L_reward", "R_reward"),

  ),
  models = list(multiRL::TD, multiRL::RSTD, multiRL::Utility),
```

```{r}
fitting.MLE <- multiRL::fit_p(
    estimate = "MLE",
```

```{r}
replay <- replay.fitting

rsp <- replay$TD[[1]]$multiRL.model@behrule@rsp

ratio <- list() 

model_names <- names(replay)
sub_names <- names(replay[[1]]) %||% 1:length(replay[[1]])

for (i in model_names) {
  ratio[[i]] <- list()
  for (j in sub_names) {
    ratio[[i]][[j]] <- replay[[i]][[j]]$multiRL.summary@metrics@ABC$ratio
  }
  ratio[[i]]

  n_subj  <- length(ratio[[i]])      # 125
  n_block <- length(ratio[[i]][[1]]) # 6
  n_rows <- n_subj * n_block

  # 2. 创建动态的数值列列表
  # replicate(n, expr) 重复创建 n_rows 个 0 的向量，共 length(rsp) 次
  # base::setNames() 设置列表元素的名称为 rsp 向量
  numeric_cols <- stats::setNames(
    object = base::replicate(
        n = base::length(rsp),
        expr = base::numeric(n_rows),
        simplify = FALSE
    ),
    nm = rsp
  )
  
  # 3. 将固定列和动态列合并到 data.frame 中
  out <- base::data.frame(
      Subject = base::integer(n_rows),
      Block   = base::integer(n_rows),
      numeric_cols
  )
  
  row_id <- 1
  
  for (j in sub_names) {           # subject
    for (k in seq_len(n_block)) {        # block
      vec <- ratio[[i]][[j]][[k]]                # numeric[4]
  
      out$Subject[row_id] <- j
      out$Block[row_id]   <- k
      for (l in 1:base::length(rsp)) {
          out[[rsp[l]]][row_id] <- vec[l]
      }
  
      row_id <- row_id + 1
    }
  }
  ratio[[i]] <- out
}


```

```{r}
replay <- replay.fitting

# 取出 rsp 名称（列名）
rsp <- replay[[1]][[1]]$multiRL.model@behrule@rsp
subid <- replay[[1]][[1]]$multiRL.model@input@colnames@subid
block <- replay[[1]][[1]]$multiRL.model@input@colnames@block
action <- replay[[1]][[1]]$multiRL.model@input@colnames@action



# 模型名与被试名
model_names <- names(replay)
sub_names   <- names(replay[[1]]) %||% seq_along(replay[[1]])

data_raw <- list()

for (s in sub_names) {
  data_raw[[s]] <- replay[[1]][[s]]$multiRL.model@input@data
}
data_raw <- do.call(rbind, data_raw)

col_block <- data_raw[[block]]
col_action <- data_raw[[action]]

# 1. 统计每个 Block 在四个选项的次数
tbl <- with(data_raw, table(col_block, col_action))

# 2. 计算比例（同行求和后除以该行总和）
ratio_raw <- prop.table(tbl, margin = 1)

# 3. 转成数据框
ratio_human <- data.frame(
  Block = as.integer(rownames(ratio_raw)),
  as.data.frame.matrix(ratio_raw)
)

ratio_human$model <- "Human"

# ---- 辅助函数：将 ratio list 展开成 data.frame ----
.expand_ratio <- function(ratio_list, rsp) {

  n_subj  <- length(ratio_list)
  n_block <- length(ratio_list[[1]])
  n_rows  <- n_subj * n_block

  # 数值列（按 rsp 动态生成）
  numeric_cols <- stats::setNames(
    object = replicate(
      n = length(rsp),
      expr = numeric(n_rows),
      simplify = FALSE
    ),
    nm = rsp
  )

  # 初始化结果表
  out <- data.frame(
    Subject = integer(n_rows),
    Block   = integer(n_rows),
    numeric_cols
  )

  row_id <- 1

  for (s in seq_len(n_subj)) {
    for (b in seq_len(n_block)) {

      vec <- ratio_list[[s]][[b]]  # numeric vector

      out$Subject[row_id] <- s
      out$Block[row_id]   <- b

      # 填入所有 rsp 数值
      for (l in seq_along(rsp)) {
        out[[rsp[l]]][row_id] <- vec[l]
      }

      row_id <- row_id + 1
    }
  }

  out
}

# ---- 主过程：从 replay 提取所有模型的 ratio ----
ratio <- vector("list", length(model_names))
names(ratio) <- model_names

for (m in model_names) {

  # 收集每个模型的被试 → block → ratio
  ratio_list <- vector("list", length(sub_names))

  for (s in seq_along(sub_names)) {
    ratio_list[[s]] <- replay[[m]][[s]]$multiRL.summary@metrics@ABC$ratio
  }

  # 展开成大表
  df <- .expand_ratio(ratio_list, rsp)
  
  df_mean <- stats::aggregate(
    x = df[, rsp, drop = FALSE],
    by = list(Block = df$Block),
    FUN = mean
  )
  
  df_mean$model <- m
  
  ratio[[m]] <- df_mean
}

ratio_robot <- do.call(rbind, ratio)


ratio <- rbind(ratio_human, ratio_robot)
rownames(ratio) <- NULL
ratio$model <- factor(ratio$model, levels = unique(ratio$model))

long_df <- reshape(
  ratio,
  varying = rsp,
  v.names = "value",
  timevar = "action",
  times = rsp,
  direction = "long"
)

# 整理 rownames
row.names(long_df) <- NULL

p <- long_df |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = Block,
      y = value,
      color = model,
      group = model
    )
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(size = 1) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(size = 2) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ action, nrow = 2) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(long_df$Block))) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = "Block",
    y = "Action Ratio",
    color = "Model"
  ) +
  .theme_apa()
p
```
